2. Dog Grooming

4. Brush-Out & Undercoat Removal

## Common Questions Answered
Q: Do you board and groom all dog breeds and sizes?
A: Yes. Dog Lady's Pet Camp cares for dogs of all breeds and sizes, from small companions to large double-coated breeds.

Q: Is this a dogs-only facility?
A: Yes. Focusing solely on dogs keeps the environment calmer and more predictable.

Q: Who will be caring for my dog?
A: Owner April Davidson, who has 29 years of grooming and veterinary-aide experience and has run Dog Lady's Pet Camp since 2000.

Q: Can you groom anxious or reactive dogs?
A: Yes. April has decades of experience with anxious, fearful, and reactive dogs, using calm handling and patience.

Q: How often should I have my dog groomed?
A: Most dogs with medium to long coats benefit from grooming every 6-8 weeks. Short-haired dogs may only need grooming a few times a year.

## Business Philosophy
Dog Lady's Pet Camp provides care that treats every dog as an individual, with attention to their unique personality, health needs, and comfort level. The owner-operated model means pet owners meet the person who will actually be caring for their dog, not a corporate staff rotation.
